summary.limits: Card-derived English development probes, not independent recall measurement. Exposure is not semantic correctness, adoption, native qualification, causal pixel improvement or user acceptance. Boundary overlap is descriptive, not a pass threshold.

Two clothed adults look toward each other through a bounded mirror while each remains visible outside it in the same frame.
